project_lysandra_context_1: Lysandra is a tactical open-world action RPG made by Faill Studio. The player is Lyra, travelling through the world of Era.
project_lysandra_context_2: The demo is playable: it is downloaded with the Faill launcher.
project_lysandra_role: Lead programmer in a team of 7. Lilian is also the only developer of everything around the game: the site, the Faill launcher and the API that distributes the updates.
project_lysandra_built_1: The Faill launcher, in Tauri 2, with signed updates.
project_lysandra_built_2: The distribution API, which serves the launcher its update files on two channels: release and preview.
project_lysandra_built_3: The game's site, whose media are stored on Cloudflare R2.
project_lysandra_built_4: The game's architecture and the player's state machine.
project_lysandra_built_5: Combat: Gameplay Ability System, targeting and poise.
project_lysandra_built_6: The monsters' AI, with a hierarchical state machine and Utility AI.
project_lysandra_built_7: The camera with Cinemachine, saving, quests and cutscenes.
project_lysandra_built_8: The bosses and the visual effects, shared with another programmer.
project_lysandra_built_9: Automated tests, and 16 recorded architecture decisions.
project_huzounet_context_1: Huzounet is Huz Studio's site, the reference for Dofus's online mode. Lilian is its developer.
project_huzounet_context_2: It brings together equipment (PvM and PvP builds), monsters and bosses, the market (prices per server and crafting returns), guides and tools: Dofmaster, Carte du monde, Familier, Brisage and PNJ Dofus. The Huz browser extension completes the site.
project_huzounet_context_3: More than 500,000 unique visitors use it every month (Cloudflare figure, November 2026).
project_huzounet_role: Sole developer of the site and all its tools. A rewrite of the site in TanStack Start is in beta.
project_huzounet_built_1: The site, in Next.js with Payload CMS and PostgreSQL.
project_huzounet_built_2: The community market, which reads players' screenshots with OCR, right in the browser.
project_huzounet_built_4: The PNJ Dofus desktop app, in Tauri 2.
project_huzounet_built_5: The Huz extension for Chrome, Firefox and Edge.
project_huzounet_built_6: The extractor of the Dofus 3 client data, and the API that serves it.
project_atelier_context_1: Atelier is an open-source visual scripting core for Unity. A gameplay behaviour has three parts: a trigger, conditions, then instructions run in order.
project_atelier_context_2: You assemble it in the Inspector or write it with the C# API, and both drive the same core. Designers assemble, programmers extend.
project_atelier_context_3: The Core package is at version 0.1.0: its API may still change before 1.0.
project_atelier_role: Alone on the project: design and development of the core, its editors and its identity.
project_atelier_built_1: The core that runs behaviours: triggers, conditions and instructions.
project_atelier_built_2: The Inspector editors, including an instruction picker sorted by category.
project_atelier_built_3: The C# API, which lets programmers extend Atelier, for example with a new condition.
project_atelier_built_4: Atelier's identity: logo, banner and icons.
project_atelier_code_intro: A condition written in C#, “Is On Screen”, appears in the Inspector next to the built-in conditions. Here it is in full.
project_atelier_signature: Assemble gameplay. In the Inspector or in C#.
